company_name: Dandong Liaodong Radioactive Instrument Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High - The company specializes in X-ray instruments used for testing single crystal materials, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Dandong Liaodong Radioactive Instrument Co., Ltd designs and manufactures X-ray crystal instruments that are utilized in the semiconductor industry for testing materials like monocrystalline silicon and gallium arsenide. Their products are certified under ISO9001 and are recognized for their advanced technology and quality.
capabilities: X-ray orientation instruments for single crystal testing

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and exports its products internationally.
